candidates.name: Monzo
candidates.description: Both companies are leading UK-based neobanks offering comprehensive mobile-first personal and business banking services similar to Revolut.
candidates.rationale: UK neobank with similar consumer and business banking products, customer base, and mobile-first financial services.

candidates.name: N26
candidates.description: Both provide a pan-European digital banking experience with multi-currency features and tiered subscription models like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable digital bank/super-app in Europe with similar consumer and business banking, FX, cards, and subscription model.

candidates.name: Starling Bank Limited
candidates.description: Both are major UK digital challengers offering full-service current accounts, business banking, and integrated financial marketplaces like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: UK digital challenger bank with consumer and business banking, comparable full-service fintech model to Revolut.

candidates.name: Wise
candidates.description: Both platforms specialize in low-cost international money transfers and multi-currency accounts for global travelers and expats like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Same fintech category: digital money transfer and multi-currency financial services for similar consumer and business users.

candidates.name: Bunq +1
candidates.description: Both offer mobile-centric banking apps with a focus on international features, sub-accounts, and travel-friendly financial tools like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable digital banking super-app with similar consumer/business banking, international payments, and travel-friendly features.

candidates.name: Monese Ltd
candidates.description: Both provide mobile-first banking alternatives that allow users to open accounts quickly and manage multiple currencies like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable mobile-first digital banking app serving consumers with multi-currency accounts and similar financial products.

candidates.name: Lunar
candidates.description: Both are digital-only challenger banks offering personal financial management, investment features, and business accounts like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Digital-only challenger bank with consumer and business accounts, payments, and investing features; closely overlaps Revolut’s model and buyer base.

candidates.name: Curve
candidates.description: Both target frequent travelers with digital wallets that offer competitive foreign exchange rates and cashback rewards like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Similar consumer fintech/digital wallet business serving similar users with payments, FX, and card products.

candidates.name: Zopa Bank Limited
candidates.description: Both have evolved from niche fintech services into fully licensed digital banks offering savings, credit, and money management like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Both are digital banks/fintech super-app style consumer finance providers with overlapping products, customers, and buying personas.

candidates.name: Chime
candidates.description: Both are high-growth fintechs providing fee-free mobile banking and early direct deposit features to retail consumers like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Same fintech category: consumer-focused mobile banking/app platform with similar products and customer base.

candidates.name: SoFi
candidates.description: Both offer a "super-app" financial experience combining banking, investing, and lending within a single mobile interface like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Both are consumer-facing digital banking super-apps offering banking, payments, investing, and lending to similar customer segments.

candidates.name: Current, Inc.
candidates.description: Both focus on mobile-first banking for the modern consumer, offering features like instant spending notifications and fee-free services like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Both are mobile-first digital banking apps for consumers, with overlapping features and target customers.

candidates.name: Nubank
candidates.description: Both are global fintech giants that disrupted traditional banking by offering simplified, app-based credit and deposit products like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Both are consumer-facing digital banking super-apps offering cards, payments, deposits, and adjacent financial services.

candidates.name: MoneyLion Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide an all-in-one financial platform that integrates banking, investing, and personalized financial insights for users like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Similar consumer fintech super-app offering banking, investing, and financial tools; comparable business model and buyer profile.

candidates.name: Dave Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer mobile banking services designed to help everyday users manage liquidity through app-based accounts and financial tools like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Both are consumer-focused digital banking apps offering mobile accounts, payments, and financial tools for everyday users.

candidates.name: Vivid Money GmbH
candidates.description: Both offer an all-in-one financial app that combines banking, multi-currency pockets, and investment options for retail users like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Directly similar consumer fintech super-app offering banking, multi-currency accounts, and investing; comparable product and buyer base.

candidates.name: Tomorrow GmbH
candidates.description: Both provide mobile-first banking services that emphasize digital-only account management and modern user interfaces like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Digital-first banking app with similar consumer/bank account services and user experience; clear Revolut-style neobank lookalike.

candidates.name: Kroo Ltd
candidates.description: Both are UK-based digital banks offering high-interest current accounts and mobile-first financial management tools like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: UK digital bank with mobile-first consumer banking and current accounts; same category and likely overlapping buyer persona as Revolut.

candidates.name: ZEN
candidates.description: Both are financial apps focused on global payments, multi-currency accounts, and shopping benefits for international consumers like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Very similar fintech model: consumer/business financial app with payments, multi-currency accounts, and card/FX features.

candidates.name: Atom bank plc
candidates.description: Both are prominent UK digital banks that operate without physical branches to provide retail and business financial services like Revolut.
candidates.rationale: Both are UK digital banks offering branchless retail and business financial services, with highly similar product and buyer profiles.
